verses.1: Thus said the LORD: “Hear your judgments, and do righteousness. For I am near to bring about my salvation, and my righteousness will be revealed.”
verses.2: And man shall do this; and a son of man shall keep it holy from being profaned. He shall also keep his hands away from doing all evil.
verses.3: And let the orphaned child who is despised say to the LORD, “Lord, separate me from my people.” But let the scoundrel not say, “I am a tree that will wither away.”
verses.4: For thus said Jehovah to the priests who keep my Sabbaths and choose those things that I have chosen, and who hold fast to my covenant.
verses.5: And I will give them a good name among the children and women. A name that will last forever. I will give it to those who will never be forgotten.
verses.6: And the descendants of the foreigners who serve Jehovah and love His name, so that they may become His servants. They are those who keep the Sabbath from being desecrated, and who hold fast to the covenant with Jehovah.
verses.7: And they shall bring him to the Holy Mountain, and they shall rejoice in My house of worship. They shall offer sacrifices according to My desire upon My altar. For My house will be a house of worship for all nations.
verses.8: May the Lord of hosts reject the insults of Israel. I will still reject them and bring them to destruction.
verses.9: All his life, he spent it in the forest, eating whatever he could find there.
verses.10: Their eyes are blind; they know nothing. They’re like dogs or cats who cannot see. They can’t even recognize the beauty of those who sleep peacefully in their beds.
verses.11: And the dogs, being very brave, did not know how to stop. And those who were evil did not understand either. They all continued on their own paths. No one tried to stop them from going forward.
verses.12: I will take it from them, and I will reward them accordingly. It will be a day that is far greater than any other day ever has been.
